About PDF to EPUB or web page

Turns a PDF into an EPUB e-book, or one web page, whose text reflows to fit a phone or e-reader screen. Chapters start at each heading. Page layout gives way to flowing text, so it suits books and reports better than forms or slides.

How to use it

  1. Add the PDF, or several.
  2. Choose EPUB e-book, or A web page for a single .html file.
  3. Tick Read scanned pages too if the pages are scans.
  4. Press Make the e-book, then open the file in your reading app or browser.

Good to know

The book is cut into chapters at its main headings, and a contents list is built from them, so a reading app can jump straight to a chapter. Page breaks are dropped, so the text runs on from one printed page to the next as one continuous read.

It works best on documents that are mostly running text: novels, reports, notes and manuals. Forms, slides, wide tables and anything laid out in boxes lose their shape once the text is set free, and are better read as PDFs in Read.

A web page is one .html file that opens in any browser with no app. It suits sending a long document to someone on a phone, or reading with a screen reader, because the words come in order and wrap to the screen. Save it and it opens again later with no connection at all.

Questions people ask

Does it work with Kindle?

Amazon’s Send to Kindle accepts EPUB files.

Can it convert a scanned book?

Tick Read scanned pages too. It is slower, and works best on clean scans.

Which apps open the EPUB?

Apple Books, Google Play Books and most e-book apps open it directly.

Is my file uploaded?

No. The e-book is put together in your browser, and the PDF never leaves your device.
